name: create_express_todo_api
description: Creates an in-memory Express CRUD todo API
prompts: Create an Express server in server.js implementing an in-memory todo API (no database, no package.json - express is already installed globally). Keep todos in memory as an array. Implement: GET /todos returns 200 with a JSON array of all todos; POST /todos accepts JSON body {"title": string} and returns 201 with the created todo {id, title, done: false} (id is a number, auto-incrementing starting at 1); GET /todos/:id returns 200 with the todo if found, else 404 with a JSON error body; PUT /todos/:id accepts JSON body with optional title/done fields, updates the todo and returns 200 with the updated todo, or 404 if not found; DELETE /todos/:id removes the todo and returns 204 with no body, or 404 if not found. Use express.json() to parse request bodies. Listen on port 8020.

test_setup_files.test_todo.py:
import subprocess, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8020{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(payload) if payload else None
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            parsed = None
        return e.code, parsed

srv = subprocess.Popen(['node', 'server.js'])
try:
    ok = False
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8020'
    assert status == 200 and body == [], f'expected empty list, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/todos', {'title': 'buy milk'})
    assert status == 201, f'expected 201, got {status}'
    assert body['title'] == 'buy milk' and body['done'] is False and isinstance(body['id'], int)
    tid = body['id']

    status, body = req('GET', f'/todos/{tid}')
    assert status == 200 and body['title'] == 'buy milk'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos/999999')
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404 for missing todo, got {status}'

    status, body = req('PUT', f'/todos/{tid}', {'done': True})
    assert status == 200 and body['done'] is True, f'expected updated done=True, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('PUT', '/todos/999999', {'done': True})
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404 updating missing todo, got {status}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
    assert status == 200 and len(body) == 1 and body[0]['done'] is True

    status, body = req('DELETE', f'/todos/{tid}')
    assert status == 204, f'expected 204, got {status}'

    status, body = req('DELETE', f'/todos/{tid}')
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404 deleting already-deleted todo, got {status}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
    assert status == 200 and body == [], f'expected empty list after delete, got {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
